creator: Alexander Terp
description:
443 of `promq`'s 732 runs pass a time flag that routes through a hand-rolled `parse_time_arg` (`promq:199-210`), because `parse_date` can't take bare `HH:MM` and auto-detection requires seconds.

The sharper case is silent: `work:327-343` can't parse Jira's `2026-05-04T23:35:52.000+0000` - the offset has no colon and there is no offset format token, so `format=` can't rescue it either. The script truncates to `[:19]` and hardcodes `tz="UTC"`, which is **quietly wrong for any non-UTC offset**.

Accept minute precision, RFC-822 style offsets, and bare time-of-day.

---

### Orientation
- `parse_date` lives in its own file, `core/func_parse_date.go`, registered as the `FuncParseDate` var (`core/func_parse_date.go:49`) and pulled into the registry at `core/funcs.go:326`.
- Docs-first flow applies: `docs/funcs/parse_date.md` holds the `## Signature` line that the type checker enforces, plus the user-facing auto-detect list and format-token table that both go stale with this change.

### Watch out for
- `convertFormatToGoLayout` is a naive `strings.ReplaceAll` chain, ordered longest-first with a comment saying why. A new token has to be checked against two collisions: against other tokens, and against the *substituted output* of an earlier replacement (Go layouts are themselves digit strings, so e.g. a token containing `07` or `01` can be eaten by a later pass). Order matters and the existing comment at `core/func_parse_date.go:11` is the contract.
- Bare time-of-day needs a date to attach to. Whatever "today" means must come from `RClock` (`core/global.go`), never `time.Now()` - `core/testing/` injects a fake clock and a real clock read makes the test non-deterministic. `RClock.Local()` is already used at `core/func_parse_date.go:57`.
- Auto-detect order is load-bearing: the list is ordered most-specific-first so a datetime isn't matched as a bare date (comment at `core/func_parse_date.go:24-28`). A bare `HH:MM` pattern inserted carelessly can start swallowing strings that used to match something else - add regression cases for the existing formats, not just the new ones.
- Widening auto-detect is a compatibility surface: a string that used to error now parses. That is the intent, but check nothing that previously matched now matches a *different* entry.
title: Widen what parse_date accepts
